title: Reproducible lazy-module provenance
objective: Harden lazy-module generation and production provenance with canonical virtual filenames/package paths, strict record validation, and receipt closure over generator configuration and every lazy Python source

oracles: Rebuild in distinct checkout roots and require byte-identical lazy records
Mutation of generator, config, or any lazy Python source changes production source closure

handoff.summary: Canonicalized lazy-module filenames and package __path__ values under /__sagejs_lazy_modules__, introduced the strict sagejs.lazy-module-bundle/v1 schema with inline templates and source hashes, rejected malformed/reserved module records, preserved correct dynamic compilation for local modules that shadow a valid shipped record, and bound the generator, configuration, and every lazy Python source into the production Wasm receipt closure. Two complete generations of 126 modules were byte-identical and contained no checkout paths.
risks: pnpm architecture:check reaches an unrelated pre-existing native-export inventory drift on this isolated base commit.
pnpm test:portable requires the integration lane to register test/lazy-module-provenance.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs; the scoped lane intentionally did not claim that shared registry.
One multiprocessing subtest needs the optional packages/flint/build/Release/sagejs_flint.node addon, which is absent in this isolated worktree; the remaining 16 multiprocessing subtests passed.
next_steps: Add test/lazy-module-provenance.cjs to the unit array in test/node-test-manifest.cjs, adjacent to test/module-cache.cjs.

Copy the generated repo dist/lazy-modules.json byte-for-byte to packages/flint-wasm/dist/lazy-modules.json and include it in the production artifact layout; validate it with scripts/lazy-module-provenance.cjs before evaluator installation.
Run node scripts/audit-native-exports.cjs --write on the integrated branch, review the unrelated export additions, and rerun pnpm architecture:check and pnpm test:portable.
